The downloaded file is retained as provenance and as a legal anatomical
rig/topology reference. The in-game 0.5.0 ant family is rebuilt and exported
from the project-authored production source. Modifications include topology
repair, new caste-specific geometry, new skin weights, a compatible runtime
skeleton, original PBR exoskeleton maps, animation repair and Unity LOD
integration.
